1.bug_scenario: In the Nav component, when 'iconOnly' mode is enabled, if a Nav.Item does not have an 'icon' prop, it still renders a blank space in the navigation bar. This results in empty or misaligned items, as shown in the screenshot, where one of the items only displays text ('it') or a blank area instead of an icon, causing a visual gap or misalignment in the vertical navigation bar.
